questions.stemEn: Which of the following would be the most appropriate title for the text?
questions.analysis: 主旨题。第一、二段引出信息技术和全球化高速发展导致高失业率和中产阶级收入下降，第三至五段深入阐释了该影响的严重程度并向个人提出努力突破平庸、成为佼佼者的应对建议，末段呼吁社会采取相应措施。第三段第2句提出主旨：today, average is over，第5句进而提出建议：to find their extra，以警醒人们不应再安于现状。文章意在说明，靠平庸过活的年代已然结束，应创造独一无二的自身价值来应对就业难的问题。[C]是对全文主旨的合理概括。[A]、[B]、[D]均以偏概全，将文中论述的某个环节当做文章主旨。

questions.stemEn: "Birds of passage" refers to those who ___.
questions.analysis: 词义理解题。Birds of passage首次出现在第一段末句，与该句主语they同指。由上一句可知，they指代回国定居的意大利移民。继续回顾上文可发现，作者提到意大利移民，是为了例证当时有不少人选择离开美国回国定居。因此birds of passage指以这些意大利移民为代表的那些无意定居国外的人，[A]正确。[B]将returned to Italy for good改为leave their home countries for good，与候鸟含义相悖。[C]借immigrants across the Atlantic干扰，但跨越大西洋的移民包含定居者和旅居客，birds of passage仅指后者。[D]利用permanent干扰，但其在文中指在国外永久居留，与birds of passage含义不同。

options.label: A
options.contentEn: stay in a foreign country temporarily

options.label: B
options.contentEn: leave their home countries for good

questions.stemEn: It is implied in Paragraph 2 that the current immigration system in the US ___.
questions.analysis: 推断题。第二段作者首先指出美国现行移民政策过于严格（rigid），将所有移民分为合法和非法，导致移民体系漏洞百出（broken），政府长期处于政治瘫痪状态（paralysis）。随后指出：我们需要超越合法与非法的严格定义，承认生活在灰色地带的候鸟，这样才能应对移民方面的挑战（we might then begin to solve our immigration challenges）。综合可知作者认为当前移民制度应做出调整以迎接挑战，[D]符合作者观点。[A]将原文We don't need more categories的否定改为肯定。[B]将原文much more rigid改为完全反义。[C]将原文政策无能为力改为相反的已通过政治手段修正。

options.label: C
options.contentEn: has been fixed via political means

options.label: D
options.contentEn: should be adapted to meet challenges

questions.stemEn: According to the author, today's birds of passage want ___.
questions.analysis: 细节题。根据题干today's birds of passage want定位至第三段第三句they prefer...。该句指出，候鸟们希望随机会的召唤而或来或走（They prefer to come and go as opportunity calls them），[C]来去的自由符合此意。题干中的want和原文prefer都表示意愿；[C]同义改写to come and go as opportunity calls them。[A]对driven by...money断章取义。[B]利用energetic participants in a global economy捏造干扰。[D]与候鸟们希望随机会而来去自如相悖。

options.label: C
options.contentEn: the freedom to stay and leave

questions.stemEn: The author suggests that the birds of passage today should be treated ___.
questions.analysis: 细节题。关于如何对待现今候鸟，作者在第二段指出不应严格将所有移民分为合法和非法，而是要承认处在灰色地带的候鸟（recognize the new birds of passage）。第四段又指出我们需要让新候鸟将美国视为暂时施展才能的地方，无需承诺永久留在美国。末段又进一步说明要超越非对即错的文化战逻辑，打开中间地带，以多种途径管理移民并允许多种结果的存在。[B]给予法律上的包容是对recognize...accommodating...multiple paths and multiple outcomes...including some that are not easy to accomplish legally等的高度概括。[A]抓住了作者对新候鸟的正面看法，但faithful有悖作者观点。[C]过度引申。[D]完全违背作者态度。

questions.stemEn: The most appropriate title for this text would be ___.
questions.analysis: 主旨题。第一段为引子介绍候鸟概念，第二段集中展现作者观点：美国现行移民政策将所有移民严格分为合法或非法，导致移民体系漏洞百出，故应承认处在灰色地带的候鸟。第三至五段全面论证作者观点。故本文主旨为将移民严格分为合法或非法非常错误，应予以调整。[D]Legal or Illegal概括了现行移民政策的体制，Big Mistake则表明作者的批评态度。[A]违背作者观点，与文章要旨相左。[B]利用文中Living and Thriving干扰，但只是文章细节而非主旨。[C]含义模糊，难以与文章内容建立明确联系。

questions.stemEn: The time needed in making decisions may ___.
questions.analysis: 细节题。第二段首先指出：判断某人是否危险人物，我们在几毫秒内便可完成；但若评估其他因素，则需要更多时间。随后进一步指出：判断某人是否爱交际可能需要一到五分钟；判断性格更为复杂的方面则需要花上一段时间。综合可知：紧急情况不同，决定所需时间不同。[D]正确。[A]源自首段且过度扩大推知。[B]将complex所指人的性格复杂面偷换为大脑反应的复杂性。[C]各情形相较可知其区别在于紧迫程度，而非重要性。

options.label: A
options.contentEn: predetermine the accuracy of our judgment

options.label: B
options.contentEn: prove the complexity of our brain reaction

options.label: C
options.contentEn: depend on the importance of the assessment

options.label: D
options.contentEn: vary according to the urgency of the situation

questions.stemEn: Our reaction to a fast-food logo shows that snap decisions ___.
questions.analysis: 细节题。根据题干signal词a fast-food logo定位至第三段。第三段指出心理学家发现：人们看到快餐标识可能导致其他非就餐行为的加速，如阅读速度加快、感觉乐曲播放时间变长等，原因在于人们无意识地将快餐与速度、急切联系起来，并将这些冲动情绪带到我们所做的事情当中。言外之意，人们无意识地将不同行为的感觉加以关联，[A]正确。根据例子为论点服务原则，段中所提及快餐旨在说明快速决策的传导性。[B]、[D]反向干扰，干扰源自unconsciously和impulses。[C]干扰源自第二段dangerous，但与本题毫无关联。

questions.stemEn: To reverse the negative influences of snap decisions, we should ___.
questions.analysis: 细节题。根据题干关键词reverse the negative influences定位至第四段。第四段首先表明我们有能力避免这些负面影响，随后列举两个例子加以说明。第一个例子即为我们如果知道销售员的微笑会促使我们做出快速决策（即冲动购物），那我们就会在购物前多想一想（以避免冲动消费），由此可清楚知道，想好之后再行动（think before we act）可以消除仓促决定的负面影响。[B]是段中例子所传达文意的高度总结和概括。[A]反向干扰。[C]望文生义。[D]以第五段中部分事实做干扰。

questions.stemEn: John Gottman says that reliable snap reactions are based on ___.
questions.analysis: 细节题。根据题干关键词John Gottman定位至第五段。段中第1句指出，John Gottman认为只有把快速反应建立在大量信息长期研究的基础上（ground such snap reactions in "thick sliced" long-term study），我们才能可靠地依据少量信息做出快速反应。也即，快速提炼出可靠的信息来自于对批量信息的长期研究，由此可推知，可靠的快速判断的基础是充分的信息（adequate information）。题干中are based on同义替换ground，正确项[C]对应long-term study。[A]干扰源自assess一词。[B]属于反向干扰，thin sliced study实际对应reliable snap reactions。[D]干扰源自explains，但无力代表实质性观点。

questions.stemEn: The author's attitude toward reversing the high-speed trend is ___.
questions.analysis: 态度题。根据题干关键词reversing the high-speed trend定位至末段。根据末段，作者首先认为能否控制快速做决断是人和动物的区别所在（Our ability to mute our hard-wired reactions by pausing is what differentiates us from animals），并在最后一句特别提出我们依然具备这种能力（We still have the imaginative capacity to rise above temptation and reverse the high-speed trend）。由此可推知，作者认为这是有希望做到的事情，持乐观态度。[B]对应We still have the imaginative capacity...，表达作者对我们有能力改变有信心。[A]、[D]干扰分别源自Although、might，而该让步旨在说明科技无力改变人的天性，反衬作者态度的肯定。[C]反向干扰。

questions.stemEn: In the European corporate workplace, generally ___.
questions.analysis: 细节题。题目问欧洲职场的总体现象，相关信息集中在第一段。该段指出：欧洲并非性别平等的天堂（not a gender-equality heaven），男性在公司高层中占绝对主导地位（remain overwhelmingly male），女性所占比例甚微（only 14 per cent）。可见男性享有最终话语权。[B]是对原文not a gender-equality heaven...remain overwhelmingly male...women hold only 14 percent of positions的高度概括。[A]是对第二句部分信息的断章取义。[C]将原文overwhelmingly曲解为企业管理遭受重大打击。[D]将senior management和family-friendly糅杂形成干扰。

questions.stemEn: The European Union's intended legislation is ___.
questions.analysis: 细节题。根据题干定位到第二段。该段首句指出欧盟正考虑立法以强迫公司董事会保持一定的女性比例，第二句指出欧盟这一做法源于一次挫折（born of frustration）。随后具体讲述挫折：瑞丁号召企业自愿参与实现性别平衡的目标，但接受呼吁者寥寥可数。整体来看，正是由于呼吁自愿参与无效，欧盟才考虑立法强迫执行，拟定此项立法实乃不得已而为之（a reluctant choice）。[C]是对born of frustration...issued a call to voluntary action...a failure...所串起的因果逻辑的概括和推理。[A]以reflection混淆逻辑关系。[B]曲解欧盟立法提案和瑞丁呼吁的关系。[D]张冠李戴：自愿行动指的是去年的瑞丁呼吁而非欧盟提案。

questions.stemEn: According to Reding, quotas may help women ___.
questions.analysis: 细节题。题目询问瑞丁认为定额给予女性的帮助，信息集中在第四段。该段指出瑞丁观点：定额可以开辟通往平等之路（open the way to equality），打破晋升障碍（break through the glass ceiling）；法国等明文规定女性在企业高层所占比例的国家即证明了这一点。定额帮助女性获得企业高层职位（get top business positions）。[A]是对该抽象信息的直观表达。[B]利用the glass ceiling的字面义干扰。[C]利用第三段need quotas...they balance work and family设置干扰。[D]利用第四段legally binding provisions设置干扰。

questions.stemEn: The author's attitude toward Reding's appeal is one of ___.
questions.analysis: 态度题。第四段阐述了瑞丁关于定额的观点：不喜欢定额，但认可定额的作用。第五段作者表明对实施配额的支持：我理解瑞丁的不情愿和沮丧（I understand Reding's reluctance – and her frustration）；我也不喜欢定额——它与我所信仰的英才管理理念相悖；但当前形势下要实现精英管理困难重重，因而确实需要强制手段来实现较为公平的世界。可见作者对瑞丁呼吁职场性别平等持赞同态度（approval）。第五段中But之后才是作者观点的体现：it does look as if a fairer world must be temporarily ordered。[A]可能因为作者不喜欢配额而产生误解，但这只是作者的让步。[B]可能因第五段从两个角度阐述而误判。[C]无中生有。

questions.stemEn: Women entering top management become headlines due to the lack of ___.
questions.analysis: 细节题。根据题干关键词become headlines与第六段的attract massive attention及第七段的newsworthy的照应关系定位。第七段用虚拟句：如果有合适的公共政策（appropriate public policies）来帮助女性……则女性高管也就不会具有如此高的新闻价值了（would be no more newsworthy），反向表明女性高管引发轰动的真正原因：缺乏合适的公共政策（suitable public policies）。题干与[C]的组合构成对第七段虚拟条件句的直接表达，suitable同义替换appropriate。[A]具有很强的干扰性，但social justice是极为抽象的概念。[B]利用原文关键词形成表面干扰但逻辑矛盾。[D]反向干扰，原文指出无论施加多少软压力都不见成效。

questions.stemEn: According to Dunn and Norton, which of the following is the most rewarding purchase?
questions.analysis: 细节题。第二段第三句至第五句明确指出：物质消费带来的满足感消退得很快（satisfaction with these material purchases wears off fairly quickly），随后指出"It is far better to spend money on experiences...like interesting trips, unique meals or even going to the cinema"（把钱花在体验上要好得多，比如有趣的旅行、特别的餐点或去看电影）。选项B"A special tour"（特别旅行）对应experiences中的interesting trips，属于体验型消费。选项A"A big house"和C"A stylish car"属于material purchases（物质消费），是作者所否定的；选项D"A rich meal"中的"rich"（丰盛的）是对原文"unique meals"（特别的餐点）的偷换概念，且原文强调的是体验的独特性而非餐食的丰盛程度。

questions.stemEn: The author's attitude toward Americans' watching TV is ___.
questions.analysis: 态度题。第三段第二句指出美国人平均每年花两个月时间看电视，"and is hardly jollier for it"（但也几乎没有因此更快乐），此处的转折和否定语气表明作者认为看电视并没有带来真正的快乐。同时作者建议"spend...less of it watching television"（少看电视），可见作者对看电视持批评态度。选项A "critical"（批评的）正确。选项B"supportive"（支持的）和C"sympathetic"（同情的）与原文相反；选项D"ambiguous"（模棱两可的）不成立，作者态度很明确。

questions.stemEn: McRib is mentioned in Paragraph 3 to show that ___.
questions.analysis: 例证题。第三段提到McRib之前，作者指出"luxuries are most enjoyable when they are consumed sparingly"（有节制地消费奢侈品才最令人愉悦）。随后用"This is apparently the reason McDonald's restricts the availability of its popular McRib"引出麦当劳限量供应McRib的例子，正是为了论证"稀缺性增加愉悦感"这一观点。选项D"rarity generally increases pleasure"（稀缺性通常增加愉悦感）正确。选项A"consumers are sometimes irrational"（消费者有时不理性）文中未提；选项B"popularity usually comes after quality"（流行通常在质量之后）曲解原文；选项C虽然提到了marketing tricks，但例证的目的是支撑"稀缺性提高愉悦感"这一论点而非营销手段的有效性。

questions.stemEn: According to the last paragraph, Happy Money ___.
questions.analysis: 细节题。最后一段最后一句指出"most people will come away from this book believing it was money well spent"（大多数看过这本书的人都会觉得它非常值得购买）。选项B"may prove to be a worthwhile purchase"（可能会被证明是一本值得购买的书）中，worthwhile purchase（值得购买）是原文money well spent（钱花得值）的同义替换。选项A"has left much room for readers' criticism"（给读者留下了很多批评空间）与原文相反；选项C"has predicted a wider income gap in the US"（预言了美国更大的收入差距）利用wealthier countries/poor ones设置干扰；选项D"may give its readers a sense of achievement"（可能给读者带来成就感）偷换概念，原文强调的是书的购买值得（money spent），而非读者获得成就感。

options.label: A
options.contentEn: has left much room for readers' criticism

options.label: B
options.contentEn: may prove to be a worthwhile purchase

options.label: C
options.contentEn: has predicted a wider income gap in the US

options.label: D
options.contentEn: may give its readers a sense of achievement

questions.stemEn: This text mainly discusses how to ___.
questions.analysis: 主旨题。全文围绕"花钱与幸福感"的关系展开：第一段以彩票赢家引入话题，引出《花钱带来的幸福感》这本书；第二段论证体验消费比物质消费更让人幸福；第三段给出具体建议（缩短通勤、多陪家人朋友等）以及"稀缺性提高愉悦感"的观点；第四段总结这本书值得一读。贯穿全文的核心问题是：如何从金钱花费中获得持久满足（fulfilment/satisfaction/happiness）。选项C"obtain lasting satisfaction from money spent"（从消费中获得持久满足）准确概括全文主旨，lasting satisfaction对应原文的lasting feelings of fulfilment。选项A"balance feeling good and spending money"（平衡感觉良好与花钱）属于片面干扰；选项B"spend large sums of money won in lotteries"（花掉彩票赢的大笔钱）仅是引子并非主旨；选项D"become more reasonable in spending on luxuries"（在奢侈品消费上更理性）过于狭隘。

options.label: A
options.contentEn: balance feeling good and spending money

options.label: B
options.contentEn: spend large sums of money won in lotteries

options.label: C
options.contentEn: obtain lasting satisfaction from money spent

options.label: D
options.contentEn: become more reasonable in spending on luxuries

questions.stemEn: According to the first paragraph, social psychologists have found that ___.
questions.analysis: 细节题。第一段指出社会心理学家发现人们存在"高于均数效应"（above average effect），即大多数人认为自己在各方面优于平均水平，如70%的人认为自己的领导能力优于常人，93%认为驾驶技术高于常人等，这些在统计上是不可能的事件（statistical impossibilities）。由此可知，社会心理学家的发现是：人们的自我评价高得不切实际。选项A"our self-ratings are unrealistically high"（我们的自我评价高得不切实际）准确概括这一发现，其中unrealistically high对应原文的statistical impossibilities。选项B"illusory superiority is baseless effect"（虚幻的优越感是没有根据的效应），illusory（虚幻的）本身就意味着没有根据，这是同义重复而非发现内容；选项C利用了leadership一词设置干扰；选项D与原文相反——这些策略是"有效的"而非"无效的"。

options.label: B
options.contentEn: illusory superiority is a baseless effect

options.label: C
options.contentEn: our need for leadership is unnatural

questions.stemEn: Visual recognition is believed to be people's ___.
questions.analysis: 细节题。第三段明确引用研究结果：视觉识别是"an automatic psychological process, occurring rapidly and intuitively with little or no apparent conscious deliberation"（一个自动的心理过程，依靠直觉快速发生，几乎没有或根本没有明显有意识的思考）。选项C"intuitive response"（直觉反应）是对原文intuitively和automatic的准确概括。选项A"rapid matching"（快速匹配）仅提及rapidly却遗漏了核心特征intuitively；选项B"conscious choice"（有意识的选择）与原文little or no apparent conscious deliberation相反；选项D"automatic self-defence"（自动的自我防卫）中的self-defence是利用原文defensive一词设置的干扰。

questions.stemEn: Epley found that people with higher self-esteem tended to ___.
questions.analysis: 细节题。第四段明确指出"those who thought that the images higher up the attractiveness scale were real directly corresponded with those who showed other markers for having higher self-esteem"（那些认为更具吸引力的照片是自己真实样子的人正是那些在其他方面表现出更强自尊心的人）。换言之，自尊心更强的人倾向于相信自己的吸引力。选项B"believe in their attractiveness"（相信自己的吸引力）是此句的同义转述。选项A"underestimate their insecurities"（低估不安全感），原文明确否定insecurities是原因；选项C"cover up their depressions"（掩盖抑郁），原文提到"If you are depressed, you won't be self-enhancing"，抑郁的人不会自我优化，与选项逻辑相反；选项D"oversimplify their illusions"（过度简化错觉），原文Epley明确说"not a delusion"（不是错觉）。

questions.stemEn: The word "viscerally" (Line 2, Para.5) is closest in meaning to ___.
questions.analysis: 词汇题。第五段第一句指出"many people hate photographs of themselves viscerally"。理解该词需结合上文Epley研究的关键发现：视觉识别是"an automatic psychological process, occurring rapidly and intuitively with little or no apparent conscious deliberation"（自动的、直觉的心理过程）。人们对真实照片的厌恶正是这种"自动、直觉、无意识"反应的表现，因此viscerally意为"本能地"。选项A"instinctively"（本能地）正确。选项B"occasionally"（偶尔地）、C"particularly"（特别地）、D"aggressively"（攻击性地）均不符合语境逻辑。

questions.stemEn: It can be inferred that Facebook is a self-enhancer's paradise because people can ___.
questions.analysis: 推断题。第五段指出Facebook是自我优化者的乐园，"where people can share only the most flattering photos, the cream of their wit, style, beauty, intellect and lifestyles"（在那里人们可以只分享最光鲜的照片和精华部分）。前文提到人们"hate photographs of themselves viscerally"（本能地讨厌真实照片）和"don't even recognise the person in the picture as themselves"（甚至不认识照片中的自己），暗示人们隐藏了不好看的方面。由此推断，人们可以在Facebook上隐藏自己不完美的一面。选项D"withhold their unflattering sides"（隐藏自己不讨喜的一面）与此逻辑一致。选项A与原文"not that people's profiles are dishonest"相反；选项B利用了traditional/lifestyles等词干扰；选项C利用intellectual一词过度推理。

questions.stemEn: According to the first paragraph, economic downturns would ___.
questions.analysis: 细节题。第一段首句指出"this phenomenon tends to be most acutely felt during economic downturns and fragile recoveries"（经济衰退和复苏乏力时期，人们对人机矛盾这一现象的感受最为强烈）。acutely felt（感受强烈）对应选项B中的highlight（凸显），machines' threat to human jobs对应原文的man versus machine这一现象。选项B"highlight machines' threat to human jobs"（凸显机器对人类工作的威胁）准确理解原文。选项A"ease the competition"（缓和竞争）与原文"most acutely felt"（感受最强烈）相反；选项C"provoke a painful technological revolution"（引发痛苦的技术革命）将"工业革命"（industrial revolution）偷换成"技术革命"；选项D中"outmode our current economic structure"将原文outmoded by machines（工作被机器取代）曲解为"经济结构过时"。

options.label: A
options.contentEn: ease the competition of man vs. machine

options.label: B
options.contentEn: highlight machines' threat to human jobs

questions.stemEn: The authors of Race Against the Machine argue that ___.
questions.analysis: 细节题。第二段末句提到"This argument has attracted a lot of attention, via the success of the book Race Against the Machine"，其中This argument指代前一句的观点："jobs that were once thought to be immune from automation suddenly become threatened"（曾被认为不受自动化影响的工作突然受到威胁），即技术减少人类工作的机会。选项A"technology is diminishing man's job opportunities"（技术正在减少人类的工作机会）是对此的准确概括。选项B"automation is accelerating technological development"（自动化正在加速技术发展）将因果关系颠倒；选项C"certain jobs will remain intact after automation"（某些工作在自动化后仍保持完整）与原文"become threatened"相反；选项D"man will finally win the race against machine"（人类最终将赢得与机器的竞赛）与全书论点相反。

options.label: A
options.contentEn: technology is diminishing man's job opportunities

options.label: C
options.contentEn: certain jobs will remain intact after automation

options.label: D
options.contentEn: man will finally win the race against machine

questions.stemEn: Hagel argues that jobs in the U.S. are often ___.
questions.analysis: 细节题。第四段Hagel指出美国的工作"tend to be 'tightly scripted' and 'highly standardized' ones that leave no room for 'individual initiative or creativity'"（往往是高度模式化和高度标准化的，没有给个人主动性或创造性留下空间）。选项D"designed against human creativity"（设计得不利于人类创造力）与此相符，against human creativity是对leave no room for individual initiative or creativity的同义概括。选项A"performed by innovative minds"（由有创新精神的人执行）与原文完全相反；选项B"scripted with an individual style"（具有个性化风格的模式化）中"individual"与原文"highly standardized"矛盾；选项C"standardized without a clear target"（标准化但没有明确目标）中的without a clear target利用target sign一词设置干扰。

questions.stemEn: According to the last paragraph, Brynjolfsson and McAfee discussed ___.
questions.analysis: 细节题。最后一段首句指出"Brynjolfsson and McAfee indeed touched on this point in their book"，this point指代前文Hagel所述的内容。前一段中Hagel强调"we more than ever need people in the workplace who can take initiative and exercise their imagination"（比任何时候更需要能发挥主动性和运用想象力的人），这正是关于人在职场中的必要性。选项D"the necessity of human involvement in the workplace"（人类参与职场的必要性）与此对应。选项A"the predictability of machine behavior"（机器行为的可预测性）是Hagel的观点而非Brynjolfsson和McAfee的观点；选项B"the formula for how work is conducted efficiently"（有效开展工作的模式）将Hagel的reinvent the formula曲解；选项C"the ways machines replace human labor"（机器取代人类劳动的方式）与末段"augment human labor rather than replace it"相反。

options.label: A
options.contentEn: the predictability of machine behavior in practice

options.label: B
options.contentEn: the formula for how work is conducted efficiently

options.label: C
options.contentEn: the ways machines replace human labor in modern times

options.label: D
options.contentEn: the necessity of human involvement in the workplace

questions.stemEn: Which of the following could be the most appropriate title for the text?
questions.analysis: 主旨题。全文围绕"人机竞赛"这一主题展开：首段引入人机矛盾的概念（man versus machine），第二段介绍《与机器赛跑》一书的观点，第三段到第六段通过Hagel的评论深入探讨为什么工作易受技术冲击以及如何应对——将"race against the machine"转变为"race with the machine"。race against the machine/race with the machine贯穿全文。选项C"Can We Win the Race Against Machines?"（我们能赢得与机器的竞赛吗？）以问句形式精准抓住全文核心论题。选项A"How to Innovate Our Work Practices?"（如何革新工作方式？）仅是末段结论的一部分；选项B"Machines Will Replace Human Labor"（机器将取代人类劳动）是全文反驳的观点；选项D"Economic Downturns Stimulate Innovations"（经济衰退刺激创新）以偏概全，信息点在首段但并非主旨。

options.label: A
options.contentEn: How to Innovate Our Work Practices?

options.label: C
options.contentEn: Can We Win the Race Against Machines?

questions.stemEn: The author believes that the housing sector ___.
questions.analysis: 细节题。第二段分析了住房行业不被提及的几个原因，最后一句指出"perhaps the most significant reason is that the issue has always been so politically charged"（最主要的原因是这个问题一直极具政治敏感性）。选项B"involves certain political factors"（涉及某些政治因素）是对politically charged的直接同义替换。选项A"has attracted much attention"（已经引起很多关注）与原文"seldom mentioned"（很少被提及）相反；选项C"shoulders too much responsibility"（承担过多责任）将原文shoulder the blame（承担责任）曲解；选项D"has lost its real value in economy"（已在经济中失去实际价值）与原文"the real value that housing can contribute"（住房能贡献的实际价值）矛盾。

options.label: D
options.contentEn: has lost its real value in economy

questions.stemEn: It can be learned that affordable housing has ___.
questions.analysis: 推断题。第四段提到政府"needs to put historical prejudices to one side and take some steps to address our urgent housing need"（需要将历史偏见搁置一边，并采取措施解决我们迫切的住房需求）。put historical prejudices to one side暗示经济适用房长期以来遭受了政府的偏见。选项C"suffered government biases"（遭受政府偏见）中biases对应prejudices。选项A"increased its home supply"（增加了住房供应）与第三段"simply not building enough new homes"（没有建造足够新房）相反；选项B"offered spending opportunities"（提供了支出机会）将原文offers an opportunity曲解；选项D利用desperate设置干扰。

questions.stemEn: According to Paragraph 5, George Osborne may ___.
questions.analysis: 细节题。第五段指出George Osborne "may introduce more flexibility to the current cap on the amount that local authorities can borrow against their housing stock debt"（可能会更灵活地放宽地方政府现行住房存量债务的借贷数额上限），即允许地方政府借更多债务用于住房建设。"if the cap were lifted"（若上限被提升）进一步印证了放宽限制的意图。选项A"allow greater government debt for housing"（允许更多用于住房的政府债务）与此相符。选项B"stop local authorities from building homes"（阻止地方当局建房）与原文相反；选项C"prepare to reduce housing stock debt"（准备减少住房债务）与原文increase灵活性的方向相反；选项D"release a lifted GDP growth forecast"（发布提升的GDP增长预测）将evidence shows的内容偷换为George Osborne的行为。

options.label: A
options.contentEn: allow greater government debt for housing

options.label: B
options.contentEn: stop local authorities from building homes

options.label: C
options.contentEn: prepare to reduce housing stock debt

options.label: D
options.contentEn: release a lifted GDP growth forecast

questions.stemEn: It can be inferred that a stable rental environment would ___.
questions.analysis: 推断题。第六段指出"creating greater certainty in the rental environment...would have a significant impact on the ability of registered providers to fund new developments from revenues"（提高租赁环境的稳定性将对注册供应商使用营业收入为新建住房提供资金的能力产生重大影响）。选项C"contribute to funding new developments"（有助于为新建住房提供资金）与原文一致，contribute to是对have a significant impact on的合理推断。选项A"lower the costs of registered providers"（降低注册供应商的成本），原文并未涉及成本问题；选项B"lessen the impact of government interference"（减少政府干预的影响）未提及；选项D"relieve the ministers of responsibilities"（减轻大臣们的责任）曲解原文。

options.label: A
options.contentEn: lower the costs of registered providers

options.label: B
options.contentEn: lessen the impact of government interference

questions.stemEn: The author believes that after 2015, the government may ___.
questions.analysis: 推断题。第七段指出"the existing 4.5bn programme of grants to fund new affordable housing, set to expire in 2015, is unlikely to be extended beyond then"（当前用于投资新经济适用房的45亿英镑拨款项目将于2015年到期，并且不大可能延期）。后文又提到"we are very unlikely to ever return to the era of large-scale public grants"（不大可能再回到大规模公共拨款时代）。由此推断，2015年后政府可能停止大规模的住房拨款。选项D"stop generous funding to the housing sector"（停止对住房行业的大方拨款）正确。选项A"implement more policies to support housing"（实施更多政策支持住房）与原文减少拨款的方向相反；选项B"review the need for large-scale public grants"中的review（重新考虑）与"unlikely to return"（不太可能回到）不符；选项C"renew the affordable housing grants programme"（续期经济适用房拨款项目）与"unlikely to be extended"（不大可能延期）相反。

options.label: A
options.contentEn: implement more policies to support housing

options.label: B
options.contentEn: review the need for large-scale public grants

options.label: C
options.contentEn: renew the affordable housing grants programme

options.label: D
options.contentEn: stop generous funding to the housing sector

questions.stemEn: According to Paragraph 1, most previous surveys found that home ___.
questions.analysis: 细节题。第一段首句指出"contrary to most surveys, people are actually more stressed at home than at work"（与大多数调查相反，人们实际上在家比上班压力更大），这说明此前的大多数调查得出的结论与此相反，即认为家庭比工作场所更让人放松。选项A "offered greater relaxation than the workplace" 与原文逻辑一致。选项B未提及；选项C与原文相反；选项D未提及。

options.label: A
options.contentEn: offered greater relaxation than the workplace

options.label: B
options.contentEn: was an ideal place for stress measurement

options.label: C
options.contentEn: generated more stress than the workplace

options.label: D
options.contentEn: was an unrealistic place for relaxation

questions.stemEn: According to Damaske, who are likely to be the happiest at home?
questions.analysis: 细节题。第二段中Sarah Damaske指出"It is men, not women, who report being happier at home than at work"（声称在家比上班更快乐的是男性而非女性），并且"the findings hold true for both those with children and without, but more so for nonparents"（该发现对有子女者和无子女者都适用，但对无子女者更为适用）。综合这两点，在家最快乐的群体应是没孩子的男性（丈夫），即选项B "Childless husbands"。选项A和D是女性，不符合；选项C "Working fathers"有孩子，不如无孩子者快乐。

questions.stemEn: The blurring of working women's roles refers to the fact that ___.
questions.analysis: 细节题。第三段指出"for women who work outside the home, they often are playing catch-up-with-household tasks"（在外工作的女性回家后经常要赶着处理家务）。"blurring of roles"（角色的模糊）指的是在外工作的女性既要挣钱养家（bread winner），又要承担家务（housewife），两种角色界限模糊。选项B "they are both bread winners and housewives"精确概括了这一含义。选项A说的是男性；选项C仅指遗留家务；选项D不够全面。

options.label: A
options.contentEn: their home is also a place for kicking back

options.label: B
options.contentEn: they are both bread winners and housewives

options.label: C
options.contentEn: there is often much housework left behind

options.label: D
options.contentEn: it is difficult for them to leave their office

questions.stemEn: The word "moola" (Line 4, Para. 4) most probably means ___.
questions.analysis: 词汇推断题。第四段中"moola"出现在"Employee puts in hours of physical or mental labor and employee draws out life-sustaining moola"。前半句说员工投入体力和脑力劳动，后半句说员工"draws out"（提取）维持生计的"moola"。根据语境，劳动换取的应是收入/金钱。且"draws out"与"earnings"搭配合理。选项C "earnings"（收入）为正确答案。选项A "skills"、B "energy"、D "nutrition"均不符合"draws out"的语义搭配。

questions.stemEn: The home front differs from the workplace in that ___.
questions.analysis: 细节题。第五段首句指出"On the home front, however, people have no such clarity"（在家庭大后方，人们就分得没这么清楚了），接着第二句进一步说明"Rare is the household in which the division of labor is so clinically and methodically laid out"（很少有家庭能非常客观且有条不紊地安排家务分工）。这与工作场所"people pretty much know what they're supposed to be doing"形成对比。选项D "division of labor at home is seldom clear-cut"是对原文的同义替换。选项A与原文"inadequate rewards"相反；选项B和C未提及。

options.label: A
options.contentEn: family labor is often adequately rewarded

options.label: B
options.contentEn: home is hardly a cozier working environment

options.label: C
options.contentEn: household tasks are generally more motivating

options.label: D
options.contentEn: division of labor at home is seldom clear-cut

questions.stemEn: Recruiting more first-generation students has ___.
questions.analysis: 细节题。第一段最后一句明确指出"This has created 'a paradox' ... means that higher education has 'continued to reproduce and widen, rather than close' an achievement gap"（这就产生了自相矛盾的现象……意味着高等教育在继续再现并扩大，而非缩小成就差距）。招收第一代大学生的初衷是缩小基于社会阶层的成就差距，但结果却事与愿违。选项C "missed its original purpose"（未能达到最初的目的）准确概括了这一结论。选项A和B与原文相反；选项D利用depressing一词干扰。

questions.stemEn: The authors of the research article are optimistic because ___.
questions.analysis: 细节题。第二段开头明确指出"But the article is actually quite optimistic, as it outlines a potential solution to this problem"（但这篇论文实际上相当乐观，因为文中概述了一种解决该问题的可能方案）。这说明乐观的原因是问题有解决办法。选项C "the problem is solvable"与此对应。选项A未提及；选项B未在乐观的语境中讨论；选项D利用"next-to-no-cost"干扰，但这不是乐观的主要原因。

questions.stemEn: The study suggests that most first-generation students ___.
questions.analysis: 细节题。第三段指出"Most of the first-generation students (59.1 percent) were recipients of Pell Grants, a federal grant for undergraduates with financial need"（大多数第一代大学生59.1%是佩尔助学金的资助对象，该助学金专门用于资助有经济需求的本科生）。这说明大多数第一代大学生需要经济资助。选项C "are in need of financial support"与此一致。选项A未提及（单亲家庭）；选项B利用"private university"干扰但并非大多数；选项D与原文不符。

options.label: C
options.contentEn: are in need of financial support

questions.stemEn: The authors of the paper believe that first-generation students ___.
questions.analysis: 细节题。第四段明确指出"first-generation students may be most lacking not in potential but in practical knowledge about how to deal with the issues that face most college students"（第一代大学生最缺乏的可能不是潜力，而是关于如何处理多数大学生都会面临的问题的实用知识）。选项B "are inexperienced in handling their issues at college"是对"lacking in practical knowledge"的同义替换。选项A利用"research"干扰但原文说的是实际的大学问题；选项C未提及；选项D与原文相悖。

options.label: A
options.contentEn: may lack opportunities to apply for research projects

options.label: B
options.contentEn: are inexperienced in handling their issues at college

options.label: C
options.contentEn: can have a potential influence on other students

options.label: D
options.contentEn: are actually indifferent to the achievement gap

questions.stemEn: We may infer from the last paragraph that ___.
questions.analysis: 推断题。最后一段指出"Because US colleges and universities seldom acknowledge how social class can affect students' educational experiences, many first-generation students lack insight about why they are struggling"（因为美国高校很少承认社会阶层能够对学生的教育经历产生影响，所以许多第一代大学生不明白他们为何如此吃力）。由此可推断，高校对于第一代大学生面临的问题负有一定责任。选项D "colleges are partly responsible for the problem in question"符合此推断。选项A与原文相反；选项B将责任推给学生，与原文语境不符；选项C将"social class helps"曲解为正面含义。

options.label: A
options.contentEn: universities often reject the culture of the middle-class

options.label: B
options.contentEn: students are usually to blame for their lack of resources

options.label: C
options.contentEn: social class greatly helps enrich educational experiences

options.label: D
options.contentEn: colleges are partly responsible for the problem in question

questions.stemEn: According to Nancy Koehn, office language has become ___.
questions.analysis: 细节题。第一段首句Nancy Koehn明确指出"the lingua franca of corporate America has gotten much more emotional and much more right-brained than it was 20 years ago"（美国企业的通用语比20年前更富情感、更偏右脑化）。选项D "more emotional"是对原文"much more emotional"的直接复现。选项A和B与原文"less strategic"、"less energetic"的表述方向不一致；选项C与"more right-brained"（更偏右脑/非理性）相反。

questions.stemEn: "Team"-oriented corporate vocabulary is closely related to ___.
questions.analysis: 细节题。第二段中Koehn解释团队导向的企业用语时指出"Let's not forget sports — in male-dominated corporate America, it's still a big deal"（不要忘了体育运动——在男性主导的美国企业中，它仍然是件大事），并进一步用"coach"（教练）和"team"（团队）的概念说明体育文化对企业用语的影响。选项A "sports culture"正确。选项B与原文"male-dominated"有关但并非核心解释；选项C和D未提及。

questions.stemEn: Khurana believes that the importation of terminology aims to ___.
questions.analysis: 细节题。第三段明确指出"These terms are also intended to infuse work with meaning — and, as Rakesh Khurana, another professor, points out, increase allegiance to the firm"（这些词语还旨在赋予工作意义，同时提高员工对企业的忠诚度）。allegiance to the firm = employee loyalty。选项D "strengthen employee loyalty"是对"increase allegiance to the firm"的同义替换。选项A利用"historically"干扰；选项B和C未提及。

questions.stemEn: It can be inferred that Lean In ___.
questions.analysis: 推断题。第四段在讨论"mommy wars"（妈咪战争）和"why women still can't have it all"（女性为何仍然不能兼顾工作与生活）的语境中提及Lean In一书，暗示该书与职业女性面临的困境相关。书名《向前一步》本身也是鼓励女性在职场上更进一步。选项A "voices for working women"（为职场女性发声）符合此推断。选项B将"passion"概念错误关联；选项C不够准确，引发争论的是"mommy wars"而非Lean In本身；选项D未提及。

questions.stemEn: Which of the following statements is true about office speak?
questions.analysis: 细节题。第五段首句明确指出"Everyone makes fun of it, but managers love it, companies depend on it, and regular people willingly absorb it"（每个人都拿它寻开心，但管理者们却喜欢它，企业依赖它，普通人乐于接受它）。"Everyone makes fun of it"对应"Regular people mock it"，"willingly absorb it"对应"accept it"。选项B "Regular people mock it but accept it"精确还原了原文含义。选项A中"linguists believe it to be nonsense"是对引语的断章取义；选项C利用"depend on it"但"fundamental"程度不当；选项D与原文"managers love it"矛盾。

options.label: A
options.contentEn: Linguists believe it to be nonsense.

options.label: B
options.contentEn: Regular people mock it but accept it.

options.label: C
options.contentEn: Companies find it to be fundamental.

options.label: D
options.contentEn: Managers admire it but avoid it.

questions.stemEn: Which part of the jobs picture was neglected?
questions.analysis: 细节题。第二段首句明确指出"However, there is another important part of the jobs picture that was largely overlooked"，紧接着点明被忽视的内容："There was a big jump in the number of people who report voluntarily working part-time"（申报自愿从事兼职工作的人数大幅增加）。选项B "The increase of voluntary part-time jobs"与此完全一致。选项A、C、D都与第一段中人们关注的正面就业数据有关，而非被忽视的部分。

options.label: A
options.contentEn: The prospect of a thriving job market.

options.label: B
options.contentEn: The increase of voluntary part-time jobs.

questions.stemEn: Many people work part-time because they ___.
questions.analysis: 细节题。第三段明确指出"Many people who work part-time jobs actually want full-time jobs. They take part-time work because this is all they can get"（许多从事兼职工作的人其实想做全职工作。他们之所以做兼职工作，是因为这是他们唯一能够找到的工作）。选项C "cannot get their hands on full-time jobs"是对"this is all they can get"的同义替换。选项A与原文相反；选项B与"having a very hard time making ends meet"矛盾；选项D未提及。

options.label: A
options.contentEn: prefer part-time jobs to full-time jobs

options.label: B
options.contentEn: feel that is enough to make ends meet

options.label: C
options.contentEn: cannot get their hands on full-time jobs

options.label: D
options.contentEn: haven't seen the weakness of the market

questions.stemEn: Involuntary part-time employment in the US ___.
questions.analysis: 细节题。第四段指出"There was an increase in involuntary part-time in June, but the general direction has been down"（六月份非自愿兼职工作有所增加，但总体呈下降趋势）。虽然6月有短期上升，但总体趋势是下降的。选项A "shows a general tendency of decline"与原文一致。选项B和C利用原文词汇干扰但扭曲了含义；选项D与原文"still far higher than before the recession"相反。

options.label: A
options.contentEn: shows a general tendency of decline

options.label: B
options.contentEn: is harder to acquire than one year ago

options.label: C
options.contentEn: satisfies the real need of the jobless

options.label: D
options.contentEn: is lower than before the recession

questions.stemEn: It can be learned that with Obamacare, ___.
questions.analysis: 推断题。最后一段明确指出"With Obamacare there is no longer a link between employment and insurance"（随着奥巴马医改的实施，就业和保险就不再挂钩了）。在此之前，"before Obamacare the only way to get insurance was through a job that provided health insurance"（获得保险的唯一途径是找到一份提供医疗保险的工作）。选项D "employment is no longer a precondition to get insurance"是对此的准确概括。选项A与原文相反；选项B与原文相悖；选项C与"allowed more than 12 million people to either get insurance"矛盾。

options.label: A
options.contentEn: it is no longer easy for part-timers to get insurance

options.label: B
options.contentEn: full-time employment is still essential for insurance

options.label: C
options.contentEn: it is still challenging to get insurance for family members

options.label: D
options.contentEn: employment is no longer a precondition to get insurance

questions.stemEn: The text mainly discusses ___.
questions.analysis: 主旨题。全文从美国就业形势谈起，重点讨论了被忽视的自愿和非自愿兼职就业问题，以及奥巴马医改对就业和保险关系的影响。全文贯穿的主线是美国就业状况。选项A "employment in the US"最全面准确地概括了全文主题。选项B只是文章涉及的一个侧面；选项C是文章后半部分涉及的具体细节；选项D将文章对奥巴马医改客观的描述曲解为负面含义。

questions.stemEn: Cortina holds that early exposure to computer science makes it easier to ___.
questions.analysis: 细节题。第一段中Cortina指出"It's not as hard for them to transform their thought processes as it is for older students"（对年龄较小的孩子而言，转换思维过程不像年龄较大的学生那样困难），即早期接触计算机科学使"转换思维方式"变得更容易。选项B "remodel the way of thinking" 是"transform their thought processes"的同义替换。选项A原文未提及；选项C将原文"test hypotheses"曲解为"formulate"；选项D将原文"create artwork"曲解为"perfect artwork production"。

questions.stemEn: In delivering lessons for high-schoolers, Flatiron has considered their ___.
questions.analysis: 细节题。第三段中Flatiron的讲师明确表示"we try to gear lessons toward things they're interested in"（我们会设法根据他们的兴趣来调整课程），即考虑学生的兴趣（interest）。选项B "interest" 是对原文的直接复现。选项A "experience"、选项C "career prospects"、选项D "academic backgrounds" 均未在原文该句中提及。

questions.stemEn: Deborah Seehorn believes that the skills learned at Flatiron will ___.
questions.analysis: 细节题。第四段中Deborah Seehorn指出"the skills they learn...apply to any coding language"（他们所学到的技能适用于任何一种编程语言），意味着这些技能将帮助学生学习其他计算机语言。选项A "help students learn other computer languages" 是对此句的同义表述。选项B将原文"may not even be relevant"（语言可能不适用）曲解为技能需要升级；选项C原文未提及；选项D未提及。

options.label: A
options.contentEn: help students learn other computer languages

options.label: B
options.contentEn: have to be upgraded when new technologies come

options.label: C
options.contentEn: need improving when students look for jobs

options.label: D
options.contentEn: enable students to make big quick money

questions.stemEn: According to the last paragraph, Flatiron students are expected to ___.
questions.analysis: 细节题。最后一段指出"These kids are going to be surrounded by computers...for the rest of their lives"（这些孩子在未来的岁月里都将会被电脑包围），以及"The younger they learn...the better"（越早学习越好），说明Flatiron的学生将更好地为数字化世界做准备。选项C "become better prepared for the digitalized world" 准确概括了此意。选项A原文未提；选项B与"might not go into IT at all"矛盾；选项D与"creating a future army of coders is not the sole purpose"矛盾。

options.label: B
options.contentEn: stay longer in the information technology industry

options.label: C
options.contentEn: become better prepared for the digitalized world

options.label: D
options.contentEn: compete with a future army of programmers

questions.stemEn: The word "coax" (Line 4, Para. 6) is closest in meaning to ___.
questions.analysis: 词义猜测题。"coax" 出现在最后一段 "how to coax the machine into producing what they want"，意为"耐心操作电脑去制作自己想要的东西"。coax的基本含义是"哄劝、耐心地引导"，结合语境即孩子们学会如何巧妙地让电脑产出想要的东西。选项A "persuade"（说服、劝导）与coax意义最接近。选项B "frighten"（吓唬）、C "misguide"（误导）、D "challenge"（挑战）均不符合语境。

questions.stemEn: The major reason for listing the lesser prairie chicken as threatened is ___.
questions.analysis: 细节题。第二段首句明确指出 "The crash was a major reason the USFWS decided to formally list the bird as threatened"（这种急剧下降是USFWS决定正式将该鸟类列为受威胁物种的一个主要原因），"crash" 指代第一段中从200万只骤降至约2.2万只的数量急剧减少。选项A "its drastically decreased population" 是原文 "crash" 的具体化表述。选项B、C、D均未在原文中作为主要原因出现。

options.label: B
options.contentEn: the underestimate of the grassland acreage

options.label: C
options.contentEn: a desperate appeal from some biologists

questions.stemEn: The "threatened" tag disappointed some environmentalists in that it ___.
questions.analysis: 细节题。第二段指出环保人士曾敦促将该鸟列为"endangered"（濒危），因为此种定位 "gives federal officials greater regulatory power"（赋予联邦官员更大的监管权力）。相比之下，"threatened"（受威胁）的标签赋予的联邦监管权力更少，因此令环保人士失望。选项C "granted less federal regulatory power" 符合题意。选项A、B、D与原文意思不符。

options.label: A
options.contentEn: was a give-in to governmental pressure

options.label: B
options.contentEn: would involve fewer agencies in action

questions.stemEn: It can be learned from Paragraph 3 that unintentional harm-doers will not be prosecuted if they ___.
questions.analysis: 细节题。第三段指出非故意伤害者不会被起诉的条件是 "as long as they had signed a range-wide management plan"（只要他们已签署大范围管理计划），该计划要求 "pay into a fund to replace every acre destroyed with 2 new acres of suitable habitat"（向基金付款以替换被破坏的栖息地）。选项A "agree to pay a sum for compensation"（同意支付补偿金）是对此的概括。选项B "volunteer to set up an equally big habitat" 是对原文的曲解；选项C和D在原文中未作为免于起诉的条件提及。

options.label: A
options.contentEn: agree to pay a sum for compensation

options.label: B
options.contentEn: volunteer to set up an equally big habitat

options.label: C
options.contentEn: offer to support the WAFWA monitoring job

options.label: D
options.contentEn: promise to raise funds for USFWS operations

questions.stemEn: According to Ashe, the leading role in managing the species is ___.
questions.analysis: 细节题。第三段末尾Ashe明确表示理念是让 "states remain in the driver's seat for managing the species"（各州在该物种管理方面处于主导地位）。"in the driver's seat" 意为"处于主导/控制地位"。选项D "the states" 是对此的直接引用。选项A "the federal government" 与原文相反；选项B和C不是Ashe所确认的主导角色。

questions.stemEn: Jay Lininger would most likely support ___.
questions.analysis: 细节题。最后一段中生物学家Jay Lininger批评该计划，说"联邦政府正将管理该鸟类的责任交给正在将其推向灭绝的同行业"。前一句提到"environmentalists say it doesn't go far enough"（环保人士说力度不够），Lininger作为生物学家批评该计划的措辞与环保人士立场一致。选项C "environmental groups" 符合题意。选项A (industry groups) 和 B (win-win rhetoric) 是Lininger批评的对象；选项D (plan) 他明确反对。

questions.stemEn: The usual time-management techniques don't work because ___.
questions.analysis: 细节题。第二段末尾明确指出原因："Deep reading requires not just time, but a special kind of time which can't be obtained merely by becoming more efficient"（深度阅读需要的不仅是时间，而且是一种仅靠提高效率无法获得的特殊时间）。选项D "what deep reading requires cannot be guaranteed" 是对此句的准确概括。选项A是部分原因但不全面；选项B和C原文未提及。

options.label: A
options.contentEn: what they can offer does not ease the modern mind

options.label: B
options.contentEn: what challenging books demand is repetitive reading

options.label: C
options.contentEn: what people often forget is carrying a book with them

options.label: D
options.contentEn: what deep reading requires cannot be guaranteed

questions.stemEn: The "empty bottles" metaphor illustrates that people feel a pressure to ___.
questions.analysis: 细节题。第三段中"空瓶子"引语表明"we feel a pressure to fill these different-sized bottles...for if they get by without being filled, we will have wasted them"（当这些不同大小的瓶子经过时，要填满它们让我们感到有压力，因为如果它们没有被填满就过去了的话，我们就是浪费了时间），即人们感到要使流逝的时间变得充实的压力。选项B "make passing time fulfilling" 精准概括。选项A和C偏离隐喻核心；选项D与原文相悖。

questions.stemEn: Eberle would agree that scheduling regular times for reading helps ___.
questions.analysis: 细节题。第四段中Eberle指出这种例行行为 "helps us 'step outside time's flow' into 'soul time'"（帮助我们"从时间流逝中走出来"，进入"灵魂时间"），即帮助实现沉浸式阅读，远离功利性时间的束缚。选项D "achieve immersive reading" 是对soul time的恰当解读。选项A与Eberle观点矛盾（"this might fuel the efficiency mind-set, but..."）；选项B和C未提及或不够准确。

questions.stemEn: "Carry a book with you at all times" can work if ___.
questions.analysis: 细节题。第四段指出该方法起作用的前提是 "reading becomes the default state from which you temporarily surface to take care of business"（阅读成为一种默认状态，你可以暂时从中抽身去处理事情），即阅读成为你一天中的主要事务。选项A "reading becomes your primary business of the day" 与此一致。选项B与"before dropping back down"逻辑相反；选项C和D未准确体现原文含义。

options.label: A
options.contentEn: reading becomes your primary business of the day

options.label: B
options.contentEn: all the daily business has been promptly dealt with

options.label: C
options.contentEn: you are able to drop back to business after reading

options.label: D
options.contentEn: time can be evenly split for reading and business

questions.stemEn: The best title for this text could be ___.
questions.analysis: 主旨题。全文围绕"如何在忙碌的生活中找到时间进行阅读"这一主题展开：第一段提出没时间阅读的普遍抱怨，第二段分析常规时间管理技巧为何无效，第三段解释效率思维与沉浸式阅读的矛盾，第四段给出切实可行的解决方案。整篇文章的核心是"如何找到时间阅读"。选项B "How to Find Time to Read" 最准确概括全文主旨。选项A过于肤浅；选项C偏离主题（文章反对设定阅读目标）；选项D不准确。

options.label: B
options.contentEn: How to Find Time to Read

questions.stemEn: One cross-generation mark of a successful life is ___.
questions.analysis: 细节题。第二段第一句明确指出跨代际的成功人生标志包括 "including getting married, having children, owning a home, and retiring in their sixties"。选项B "having a family with children" 是原文 "having children" 的同义表述，属于传统成功标志之一。选项A与"strikingly different paths"形成干扰但与题意不符；选项C与原文"retiring in their sixties"相反；选项D原文未含。

questions.stemEn: It can be learned from Paragraph 3 that young people tend to ___.
questions.analysis: 细节题。第三段列出了年轻人比年长者更倾向于做的五件事，其中包括 "to agree that couples should be financially secure before getting married or having children"（赞成夫妻在结婚或生子前应有经济保障）。选项C "attach importance to pre-marital finance"（重视婚前经济状况）是对此的准确概括。选项A与"a faster pace of life"相反；选项B与"regularly changing jobs"相反；选项D是对"children are best served by two parents working outside the home"的曲解。

options.label: D
options.contentEn: give priority to childcare outside the home

questions.stemEn: The priorities and expectations defined by the young will ___.
questions.analysis: 细节题。第四段明确提到年轻人定义的优先事项和期望 "will increasingly spread through virtually all aspects of American life, from consumer preferences to housing patterns to politics"（将逐渐蔓延到美国人生活的几乎所有方面）。选项D "reach almost all aspects of American life" 是此句的直接复述。"virtually all aspects" = "almost all aspects"。选项A、B、C均不能完整体现原文含义。

options.label: D
options.contentEn: reach almost all aspects of American life

questions.stemEn: Both young and old agree that ___.
questions.analysis: 细节题。第五段首句指出 "Young and old converge on one key point: Overwhelming majorities of both groups said they believe it is harder for young people today to get started in life than it was for earlier generations"（双方在一个关键点上趋于一致：现在年轻人的人生更难起步）。选项D "getting established is harder for the young" 是对 "harder...to get started in life" 的同义替换。get started in life = get established。选项A是对原文的过度推断；选项B和C原文未提及。

options.label: B
options.contentEn: the old made more life achievements

options.label: C
options.contentEn: housing loans today are easy to obtain

options.label: D
options.contentEn: getting established is harder for the young

questions.stemEn: Which of the following is true about Schneider?
questions.analysis: 细节题。最后一段Schneider说道 "I still grew up in an upper middle-class home with parents who didn't have college degrees"（我仍然在一个上层中产阶级家庭中长大，虽然我的父母并没有大学文凭），这说明他父母的好生活与大学学历关系不大。选项C "His parents' good life has little to do with a college degree" 正确。选项A与"struggled to find a job"矛盾；选项B原文未提及；选项D是对原文的曲解。

options.label: A
options.contentEn: He found a dream job after graduating from college.

options.label: B
options.contentEn: His parents believe working steadily is a must for success.

options.label: C
options.contentEn: His parents' good life has little to do with a college degree.

options.label: D
options.contentEn: He thinks his job as a technician quite challenging.

questions.stemEn: According to Paragraph 1, Parkrun has ___.
questions.analysis: 细节题（实则考查段落主旨概括）。第一段从多角度展现公园跑的大获成功：每周六早上定时举行，每次人数超过5万；始于十来个朋友，如今在全国激起400场活动，国外更多；活动涉及数千名志愿者；参加者老少皆有，成绩各异。综合全段细节可知，该活动已赢得巨大欢迎，因此[A]正确。[B]将原文"数千名志愿者担任工作人员"曲解为"创造了许多工作"；[C]由"本地公园""朋友""老少皆有"等片段臆想出来，但原文未提及人们之间的交往互动；[D]由"世界纪录"主观推出"官方/正式赛事"，但实际恰恰相反，这是一种自由参加的民间活动。

questions.stemEn: The author believes that London's Olympic "legacy" has failed to ___.
questions.analysis: 细节题。第二段指出，伦敦奥运会遗产预期能够促进国民参与运动、促进国民健康；但结果却是每周运动的成人人数下降，小学生运动人数减半，肥胖人数增加。可见奥运遗产未能提升运动参与，[B]正确。[A]将"运动人数下降"曲解为"总人口下降"，且原文明确指出人口在快速增加；[C]结合常识（举办奥运会有助于提升城市形象）和原文片段设置干扰，但作者关注的是运动参与及国民健康，无关城市形象；[D]将"每周运动至少两小时的小学生数量减半"偷换对象为"校内运动时间减半"。

questions.stemEn: Parkrun is different from Olympic games in that it ___.
questions.analysis: 细节题（事物比较）。第三段以by contrast将公园跑和奥运会进行对比。公园跑不是竞赛而是计时赛，欢迎任何人参加，所有人都能获得同样的快乐。相比之下，奥运申办者双重目标：既要让更多人参与运动，又要产生精英运动员，且实际上强调成功胜过参与，令新手望而生畏。因此二者区别在于公园跑不强调精英主义，[C]正确。[A]将奥运会的目的"发现天才"当做公园跑的特征；[B]利用competitor和welcomes anybody糅杂形成干扰，但原文强调公园跑鼓励大众运动，并不强调竞争；[D]将奥运会的缺点"吓退新手"当做公园跑的特征。

questions.stemEn: With regard to mass sports, the author holds that governments should ___.
questions.analysis: 作者观点题。第四段指出政府就促进大众体育的正确做法应当是提供公共物品——确保运动场地空间、到位铺设球场的资金、鼓励学校体育运动。后文也建议"未来政府需要为体育繁荣提供条件"。因此[D]"投资公共体育设施"是对上述建议的概括。[A]将作者批判的错误做法（政府参与草根运动规划）当做作者建议；[B]对原文"压缩地方资金"断章取义，将政府一直错误地压缩资金理解为应监管当地体育组织；[C]将"确保铺设球场的资金"偷换对象为"增加对体育俱乐部的投资"。

questions.stemEn: The author's attitude to what UK governments have done for sports is ___.
questions.analysis: 态度题。第四段前三句指出，政府参与规划基层体育运动有点可笑（a little absurd）；政府正确做法应该是确保公共设施到位，而实际上一届届政府却出售绿地、压缩地方资金、拒绝关注学校运动。最后两句向未来政府提出建议：为繁荣体育事业多干实事，至少不要让情况变得更糟。文中"absurd"、"But successive governments..."、"wordy, worthy strategies"等均传递批判态度，因此[B]正确。[A]由"至少不让情况更糟"曲解为作者持容忍态度，但实则是作者对未来政府的底线要求，暗含对已有行为的强烈不满；[C]因文中既有贬义词又有褒义词而误判，但worthy此处是褒词贬用；[D]对原文断章取义，将作者批判的内容当做赞同。

questions.stemEn: According to Jenny Radesky, digital products are designed to ___.
questions.analysis: 人物观点题。首段引用Jenny Radesky的话："科技旨在将你真正卷入其中，数字产品就是为了促进最大参与。这使你难以自拔，且渗透到家庭日常之中。"可见Jenny Radesky认为数字产品的设计初衷在于吸引用户注意力，[B]正确。其中"absorb user attention"对应原文"promote maximal engagement"和"suck you in"。[A]截取routine捏造干扰；[C]将"促进对数字产品的最大使用"错误理解为"促进人际交流"；[D]将"促进最大参与"错误理解为"提高工作效率"。

questions.stemEn: Radesky's food-testing exercise shows that mothers' use of devices ___.
questions.analysis: 细节题（研究/实验发现）。第二段介绍Radesky的食物测试研究发现：使用数字设备的母亲与孩子的语言交流减少了20%，非语言交流减少了39%。可见母亲使用数字设备会减少其与孩子的交流，[D]正确。[A]利用mealtimes、food-testing等词捏造干扰，但研究观察的不是孩子食欲；[B]改变原文逻辑关系：将"孩子努力获取父母注意力时父母在使用设备"改为"父母使用设备会分散孩子注意力"；[C]由"语言交流减少20%"主观臆断出"减缓孩子语言发展"，原文未提及该影响。

questions.stemEn: Radesky cites the "still face experiment" to show that ___.
questions.analysis: 人物观点题（引用实验的目的）。第三段介绍了面无表情实验：母亲先与孩子正常交流，随后做出面无表情的姿态——孩子变得越来越苦恼。段末Radesky总结观点："父母不必时刻完美陪伴，但需要有一个平衡，父母需要对孩子情感需求的口头或非口头表达给予回应和体恤。"由此可知Radesky引用实验意在提醒父母回应孩子的情感需求，[D]正确。[A]将"孩子越来越苦恼"篡改为"容易习惯"；[B]与原文观点相悖，且emotional exchange未触及论述焦点（父母与孩子的互动）；[C]将"父母面无表情"错误理解为"孩子对父母情绪变化不敏感"。

options.label: A
options.contentEn: it is easy for children to get used to blank expressions

options.label: B
options.contentEn: verbal expressions are unnecessary for emotional exchange

options.label: C
options.contentEn: children are insensitive to changes in their parents' mood

options.label: D
options.contentEn: parents need to respond to children's emotional needs

questions.stemEn: The oppressive ideology mentioned by Tronick requires parents to ___.
questions.analysis: 细节题（长难句关键信息提取）。第四段首句指出，压制性意识形态"要求父母必须一直与孩子保持互动"（that demands that parents should always be interacting with their children）。同时冒号后的直接引语也以"if you're failing to expose your child to 30,000 words you are neglecting them"进一步说明这种意识形态要求不断与孩子交流。因此[C]正确。[A]糅杂fantasised和expose your kids to等片段设置干扰；[B]曲解"使孩子接触到3万词"的内涵，该信息意在说明亲子语言交流的量，而非每年教孩子多少词汇；[D]利用"worries about kids' use of screens"设置干扰，但这是意识形态造成的后果而非其本身内容。

options.label: A
options.contentEn: protect kids from exposure to wild fantasies

options.label: B
options.contentEn: teach their kids at least 30,000 words a year

options.label: C
options.contentEn: ensure constant interaction with their children

options.label: D
options.contentEn: remain concerned about kids' use of screens

questions.stemEn: According to Tronick, kids' use of screens may ___.
questions.analysis: 人物观点题。第四段句指出Tronick对孩子使用数字产品的看法："仅仅因为孩子没有从数字产品上学到东西，并不意味着它没有任何价值——特别是如果它能让父母有时间洗澡、做家务或仅仅是从孩子身边稍作休息。"即孩子使用数字产品可以给父母一些自由时间，[A]正确。[B]将"从使用数字设备中获益良多"错误理解为"获得创造力"，且原文侧重父母对设备的使用；[C]将多重否定句式"just because a child isn't learning...doesn't mean there's no value"理解为与之相悖的"帮助完成作业"；[D]利用第一段suck you in、promote maximal engagement形成干扰，但这是Radesky观点且与"更专心"方向相反。

options.label: A
options.contentEn: give their parents some free time

questions.stemEn: One of the reasons for high-school graduates not taking a gap year is that ___.
questions.analysis: 因果细节题。首段句说明外因（社会压力和期望）导致毕业生完全忽视间隔年，句以After all补充内因：周围人都直入大学，独自留待一年显得愚蠢（从众心理）；连读12年书突然休整一年感觉有违常理（惯性心理）。可见毕业生不选间隔年是因为做法和别人不一样令人不安，[C]正确概括了这种从众心理。[A]把"休间隔年即暂停学业"曲解为"间隔年在学业上误人子弟"；[B]把碎片信息immediately go to college、high expectations糅杂臆断，但前者源于社会压力而非自身兴趣；[D]把间隔年的内涵（体验学业以外的事情）偷换为"修读校外课程"。

options.label: B
options.contentEn: they have a lot of fun to expect in college

options.label: C
options.contentEn: it feels strange to do differently from others

options.label: D
options.contentEn: it seems worthless to take off-campus courses

questions.stemEn: Studies from the US and Australia imply that taking a gap year helps ___.
questions.analysis: 细节题。第三段借美、澳两国研究指出：经历间隔年的学生对大学准备更充分、表现更好；间隔年不是退步而是推动进步，帮助学生为独立、新责任和环境变化做好准备——这些正是一年级新生最挣扎的事；间隔年可以缓解适应大学新环境的冲击。概括而言，间隔年有助于减轻新生的压力，[D]正确。[A]反向曲解第二段中"出于担心落于人后的现实考量"；[B]源自第二段"a lucrative career"，但该内容只是举例说明社会快节奏氛围；[C]利用第四段financial impact、costly进行干扰，但数据源自国家教育统计中心而非美澳研究。

questions.stemEn: The word "acclimation" (Para. 3) is closest in meaning to ___.
questions.analysis: 词义推断题。第三段句指出，间隔年经历可以使人们更容易专注学业和活动，而非acclimation blunders。由rather than的取舍之意可知，acclimation blunders与"专注学业和活动"对立。上文说明新生最头疼的事是"独立、新责任和环境变化"，即适应新环境的问题。因此acclimation意为"适应"，[A]正确。[B]源自第四段college applications，但脱离上下文对大学新环境的讨论；[C]从句a gap year pushes them ahead臆测出"积极性"，但曲解了取舍关系；[D]源于第二段竞争压力，但专注学业与竞争问题不合逻辑。

questions.stemEn: A gap year may save money for students by helping them ___.
questions.analysis: 细节题。第四段首句指出：如果对间隔年发现和探索兴趣的价值仍有疑问，那么请考虑其对未来学业的经济影响。随后引用数据：近80%的大学生至少转过一次专业，原因是高中课程使他们对大学各种专业缺乏了解。转专业若太晚，补修学分代价高昂。间隔年能帮助学生从一开始就弄清楚事情，选定正确专业，从而避免转专业带来的金钱浪费。因此[D]正确。[A]源自第三段perform better，但讲述的是适应新环境的作用而非经济影响；[B]由"常换专业"推出大学生缺乏恒心，但原文原因是缺乏了解而非缺乏耐心；[C]将"转专业(switching to another major)"曲解为"转学(switching to another college)"。

questions.stemEn: The most suitable title for this text would be ___.
questions.analysis: 主旨题。全文按照"介绍普遍现象（毕业生完全忽视间隔年）——提出相反观点（间隔年不会妨碍反而有助于学业成功）——论证观点（第三、四段分析间隔年的积极作用）"的脉络展开，旗帜鲜明地为间隔年平反。因此[A]"支持间隔年"准确体现全文立意和作者态度。[B]暗示全文围绕间隔年基本知识展开，但文中仅在论证价值时涉及基本作用，不足以概括主旨；[C]对应"间隔年由盛转衰后重获重视"，与文中"当前学生完全忽视间隔年"不符；[D]关键词Dilemma表示模棱两可的态度，暗示利弊参半，违背作者明确支持间隔年的态度。

options.label: A
options.contentEn: In Favor of the Gap Year

options.label: B
options.contentEn: The ABCs of the Gap Year

questions.stemEn: More frequent wildfires have become a national concern because in 2015 they ___.
questions.analysis: 因果细节题。第一段明确指出日益频繁的森林大火因其对联邦税款的影响而发展为举国关切之事。第二段以2015年数据例证：美国林务局首次将55亿美元年度预算的一半以上用于抗击火灾——这一比例几乎是20年前的两倍。因此森林大火成为举国关切之事是因为2015年森林大火花费了破纪录的高比例预算，[B]正确。[A]利用碎片信息for the first time、efforts、management捏造"史无前例的管理力度"；[C]利用western states、ecology捏造西部州生态问题，但文意重在讲述火灾给全国税款带来的影响；[D]将infrastructure upkeep（基础设施养护）曲解为infrastructure expenditure（基础设施支出），且将"费用减少"反向干扰为"支出大幅增加"。

options.label: B
options.contentEn: consumed a record-high percentage of budget

options.label: C
options.contentEn: severely damaged the ecology of western states

options.label: D
options.contentEn: caused a huge rise of infrastructure expenditure

questions.stemEn: Moritz calls for the use of "a magnifying glass" to ___.
questions.analysis: 推理引申题（含比喻修辞）。第四段中莫里茨说"要用放大镜来看待这个问题"，随后以正反设问解释："等一等，这么做可以吗？要不要反而将这些资金投向该地景低风险区域？"换言之，要多提问、多审思以确保联邦资金的投向准确无误，即确保公共资金的支出更可靠，[D]正确。[A]利用magnifying glass的字面意（放大）捏造raise more funds；[B]首先将those funds范围扩大至federal money，其次将该句疑问之意曲解为充分肯定的否定之意；[C]将"低风险区域"偷换为"无风险区域"，且文中未提及"寻找无风险区域"。

options.label: A
options.contentEn: raise more funds for fire-prone areas

options.label: B
options.contentEn: avoid the redirection of federal money

options.label: C
options.contentEn: find wildfire-free parts of the landscape

options.label: D
options.contentEn: guarantee safer spending of public funds

questions.stemEn: While admitting that climate is a key element, Moritz notes that ___.
questions.analysis: 细节题（人物观点）。第七段明确指出莫里茨观点："气候尽管是一个关键要素，但不应以牺牲其他影响因素为代价"（it shouldn't come at the expense of the rest of the equation）。即不应忽略其他因素，[C]正确。[A]源自第六段"how...is leading to..."，但将"晤谈焦点在于探究地球变暖如何导致火灾恶化"曲解为"公开讨论尚无定论"；[B]反向曲解原文"地球变暖诱发使火灾恶化的条件"；[D]源自第五段shift in the way...views fire，但将"期望：应改变看待火灾的方式"曲解为"事实：已发生改变"。

options.label: A
options.contentEn: public debates have not settled yet

options.label: C
options.contentEn: other factors should not be overlooked

options.label: D
options.contentEn: a shift in the view of fire has taken place

questions.stemEn: The overly simplified view Moritz mentions is a result of failing to ___.
questions.analysis: 因果细节题。第八段首先指出："人类系统和我们赖以生存的地景相互关联，且相互作用是双向的。"随后指出："未能认识到这一点（Failing to recognize that），就会导致对可能的解决方案持有过于简化的看法。"其中that回指前文"人类系统与地景之间相互联系、相互影响"。因此过度简化的看法的原因是：未能掌握人类和自然的相互关系，[D]正确。[A]和[B]将双向关联割裂为单向研究某一方面的构成；[C]将双向的相互作用单向割裂为"地景对人类生活的作用"。

options.label: A
options.contentEn: discover the fundamental makeup of nature

options.label: B
options.contentEn: explore the mechanism of the human systems

options.label: C
options.contentEn: maximize the role of landscape in human life

options.label: D
options.contentEn: understand the interrelations of man and nature

questions.stemEn: Professor Balch points out that fire is something man should ___.
questions.analysis: 推理引申题（人物观点）。第九段指出：人们长期以来将火灾视为需要完全控制的事件，但巴尔奇教授认为应承认火灾在人类生活中不可避免的存在。第十段进一步指出：人们已将自身生活与火灾完全割裂，但理解并梳理当今人类与火灾的关联至关重要。综合可知，巴尔奇认为火灾不可避免、人与火灾密不可分、人类应与火灾和谐共存，即"与之妥协"，[B]正确。[A]将人们错误认知（火灾应被全面控制）当做巴尔奇观点；[C]由"火灾不可避免"捏造出"人类要为火灾付出代价"这一因果关联；[D]将人们错误做法（将自身生活与火灾割裂）曲解为巴尔奇观点。

questions.stemEn: A broken bike chain is mentioned to show students' lack of ______.
questions.analysis: 写作目的题。第二段第二句指出：Koziatek所在高中开创性地将学习视为不是关于书本，而是关乎实际（not something of books and tests and mechanical memorization, but practical）。第二段第三句反问：究竟何时人们开始普遍认为学生应该能够说出第13任总统的名字、却面对断裂的自行车链不知所措（be utterly overwhelmed by a broken bike chain）。可见，提及自行车链事例是为了说明学生实际动手能力的欠缺，[A]正确。[B]方向错误：学术培训是当前教育强调的内容，并非学生欠缺的能力。[C]偷换概念：将Koziatek所在学校的开创精神（pioneering）偷换为学生的开创精神。[D]干扰方式与[B]相似，将机械记忆（mechanical memorization）这一当前教育强调的对象当做学生欠缺的能力。

questions.stemEn: There exists the prejudice that vocational education is for kids who ______.
questions.analysis: 事实细节题。第四段指出一种偏见：认为体力劳动是低等的（Working with your hands is seen as almost a mark of inferiority），职业教育是面向无法取得学业成功的孩子（Schools in the family of vocational education "have that stereotype...that it's for kids who can't make it academically"）。可见[C]are not academically successful是对原文can't make it academically的改写，正确。[A]将第四段第三句"职业学校有一种模式化认识（have that stereotype）"改为"职业教育面向的是思维模式化的学生"。[B]对原文"who can't make it"断章取义为缺乏职业动机，文中并未提及学生的职业动机。[D]将第四段第二句"inferiority（体力劳动被认为不如脑力劳动）"曲解为"financially disadvantaged（经济条件差）"，文中并未提及学生的家庭经济条件。

questions.stemEn: We can infer from Paragraph 5 that high school graduates ______.
questions.analysis: 段落推理题。第五段第三句指出，随着制造业不再是经济引擎（Manufacturing is not the economic engine that it once was），美国经济曾经提供给高中毕业生的工作保障大部分已消失（The job security that the US economy once offered to high school graduates has largely evaporated），即高中毕业生曾因制造业的繁荣而享有比现在多的工作机会，[B]正确——是对原文反向同义表述。[A]推理方向错误：由第五段第三句"曾经的工作保障消失"可知，现在的高中毕业生应该比过去有更大的经济困扰，而非过去有巨大的经济困扰。[C]对原文解读错误：将制造业衰落导致高中毕业生工作安稳性不再改为高中毕业生不愿意进入制造业。[D]曲解原文：将"我们想要孩子接受更多的教育"理解为"我们赋予了高中毕业生更多的教育特权"。

options.label: A
options.contentEn: used to have big financial concerns

options.label: B
options.contentEn: used to have more job opportunities

options.label: C
options.contentEn: are reluctant to work in manufacturing

options.label: D
options.contentEn: are entitled to more educational privileges

questions.stemEn: The headlong push into bachelor's degrees for all ______.
questions.analysis: 事实细节题。第六段第一句指出，向所有人推行学士学位、并暗中贬低其他较低的一切并非美国经济唯一所需（misses an important point: That's not the only thing the American economy needs）。第二、三句进一步指出，学士学位虽然会带来更多机会，但美国大部分的工作依然是中等技能工作（54 percent of the jobs in the country are middle-skill jobs）。可见，让所有人读大学高估了高等教育的重要性，[D]正确。[A]断章取义：由"Yes...But..."形成的让步转折可知学士学位带来的机会并非指中等技能工作。[B]利用第七段"There is a gap in working-class jobs"干扰，但填补这一空缺的是Koziatek所在学校的教学模式，而非向所有人推行学士学位。[C]源自第六段"only 44 percent of workers are adequately trained"，但同样由"Yes...But..."可知，向所有人推行学士学位无法生成更加训练有素的劳动力。

options.label: A
options.contentEn: helps create a lot of middle-skill jobs

options.label: B
options.contentEn: may narrow the gap in working-class jobs

options.label: C
options.contentEn: is expected to yield a better-trained workforce

options.label: D
options.contentEn: indicates the overvaluing of higher education

questions.stemEn: The author's attitude toward Koziatek's school can be described as ______.
questions.analysis: 作者态度题。首段指出Koziatek在努力给学生一个更好的未来。第二、三段介绍Koziatek所在高中的开创性教学（pioneering），并指出这是一种可行的学习方式，符合学习的多样性。第四至七段批驳当前偏见，指出这符合当前经济发展所需及学生就业所需。末段概括评论：这无异于叫醒电话、令人清醒（Koziatek's school is a wake-up call）。可见作者对Koziatek所在学校非常支持，[A]正确。[B]将作者对传统教育的评判和对Koziatek学校的论述糅杂在一起，实际上作者对传统教育的批驳并不意味着对Koziatek学校仅仅是"容忍"。[C]将文中以mechanical、forcing、misses an important point等表明的对传统教育的态度当做对Koziatek学校的态度。[D]曲解开篇"he has to justify..."以及文末"it risks..."，认为作者态度是谨慎的。而实际上开篇意在说明Koziatek努力面对颇多质疑，结尾指向当前的传统教育。

questions.stemEn: The word "plummeting" (Line 3, Para.2) is closest in meaning to ______.
questions.analysis: 词义推断题。将被考词所在句（第二段第二句）与其前后文（第一、三句）结合可知：一、第二句借But表明与第一句间转折关联，即第一句意在转承可再生能源发展的部分原因（政府及有远见企业的资金承诺），第二句指出更为主要的原因——可再生能源的价格，尤其是风能和太阳能；二、第三句借solar panels、wind turbines照应第二句renewables，especially wind and solar形成例证关联，即第三句以太阳能电板、风力涡轮机成本分别下降80%、近三分之一例证第二句"可再生能源的价格"。由此不难得知plummeting意指"正在下降的"，即[C]falling正确。[A]stabilizing由第一句"获得政府及企业资金支持"捏造出"稳定的"之意。[B]changing虽囊括"下降的"之意，却也藏有"增长的"之意，总体暗示价格波动时升时降，与原文语义相悖。[D]rising由段中growth、increasingly望文生义而来。

questions.stemEn: According to Paragraph 3, the use of renewable energy in America ______.
questions.analysis: 事实细节题。第三段第三句指出：在其他国家（尤其中国、欧洲）领先之际，美国也迎来显著改变（the United States is also seeing a remarkable shift）；第四句进而以数据解释：3月美国风能、太阳能发电占比首次超过10%（wind and solar power accounted for more than 10 percent of the power generated in the US）。由此可见，美国可再生能源的应用正在取得显著进步，[A]正确。[B]由第三句also捏造而来，但该词在句中实际用以表明两种不同的良性发展状况：中国、欧洲等其他国家在可再生能源使用方面遥遥领先，美国则在见证显著转变，而非两种相似的使用情况。[C]、[D]均由第四段第一句特朗普对待可再生能源的态度捏造而来，但并非题干所考查的第三段内容。

options.label: B
options.contentEn: is as extensive as in Europe

questions.stemEn: It can be learned that in Iowa, ______.
questions.analysis: 事实细节题。根据in Iowa可直接定位至第四段第二、三句。其中第二句指出特朗普在爱荷华州直接将风能摒弃为不靠谱能源，第三句前半句转而指出这一说法在爱荷华州并不被买账（did not play well with many in Iowa），后半句随即呈现该州实际情况：风力涡轮机遍布田野并且供应该州36%的发电量（wind turbines dot the fields and provide 36 percent of the state's electricity generation）。由此可见，风能是被广泛应用的能源，[A]正确。[B]只见"dot the fields"却未见"provide 36 percent"，将遍布田野夸大为取代化石燃料而忽视占比36%（不及一半）。[C]将第三句末"因被爱荷华州清洁能源的易获得性而吸引"曲解为"科技巨头正在投资清洁能源"。[D]与[B]恰相反，只见"provide 36 percent"未见"dot the fields"，将占比36%狭隘理解为供给不足，与第三句"清洁能源极易获得"相悖。

options.label: A
options.contentEn: wind is a widely used energy source

options.label: B
options.contentEn: wind energy has replaced fossil fuels

options.label: C
options.contentEn: tech giants are investing in clean energy

options.label: D
options.contentEn: there is a shortage of clean energy supply

questions.stemEn: Which of the following is true about clean energy according to Paragraphs 5&6?
questions.analysis: 是非判断题。第五段第二句指出电池存储容量的提升使得连续不断供电变得更为可能（a boost in the storage capacity of batteries is making their ability to keep power flowing around the clock more likely），意即可再生能源有望实现持续供应，故[C]正确——是对原文making their ability to keep power flowing around the clock more likely的合理改写。[A]将第五段第二句中的因果逻辑颠倒：原文是"电池存储容量的提升促成清洁能源的持续供应"，选项改为"清洁能源的应用提升了电池存储容量"。[B]将第六段第一句"汽车制造商的巨额投资推动可再生能源电池存储容量提升"曲解为"可再生能源通常用于汽车制造业中"。[D]由第五段第一句怀疑论者论调"不出太阳、不刮风时，可再生能源供应将遇挫"捏造出"可持续开发困难重重"，而真实文意是可再生能源持续供应将越来越有可能成为现实。

options.label: A
options.contentEn: Its application has boosted battery storage.

options.label: B
options.contentEn: It is commonly used in car manufacturing.

options.label: C
options.contentEn: Its continuous supply is becoming a reality.

options.label: D
options.contentEn: Its sustainable exploitation will remain difficult.

questions.stemEn: It can be inferred from the last paragraph that renewable energy ______.
questions.analysis: 段落推理题。末段第三句指出：在全球思想转型之际，无论华盛顿（美国政府代称）在推动可替代能源中做什么或不做什么，其对全球可再生能源不可阻挡强劲之势的影响力愈来愈小（What Washington does -- or doesn't do -- to promote alternative energy may mean less and less at a time of a global shift in thought）。此句实际暗藏文意为不管美国政府鼓励不鼓励可再生能源发展，其全球发展势头都势不可挡，言外之意亦即美国政府并未真正鼓励可再生能源发展，故[C]正确。[A]中"使美国更接近于其他国家"与文末句"mean less and less at a time of a global shift in thought"相悖——全球思想转型之际，影响力愈来愈小即意味着全球在变，美国不变，其与其他国家差距愈来愈大。[B]中"accelerate"与第三句中的"slowing climate change"相悖。[D]属于只见树木不见森林——只见从句"there's a long way to go"，未见主句"the trend lines for renewables are spiking"，与趋势上扬所蕴藏的具有竞争力相悖。

options.label: A
options.contentEn: will bring the US closer to other countries

options.label: C
options.contentEn: is not really encouraged by the US government

options.label: D
options.contentEn: is not competitive enough with regard to its cost

questions.stemEn: According to Paragraph 1, Facebook acquired WhatsApp for its ______.
questions.analysis: 事实细节题。首段第一句破折号后指出Facebook高价收购没有任何实体产品的WhatsApp，第二句暗示原因：WhatsApp能为其提供一张精细的用户朋友关系和社交生活网（an intricate and finely detailed web of its users' friendships and social lives），也即用户信息，[B]正确。[A]、[C]源于第一句"没有任何实体产品"（doesn't have any physical product），但文中"在线通信服务"不同于"数字产品"如电子书、电子音乐等；[C]中的资产问题在文中并未提及。[D]将表褒义的词汇intricate and finely detailed与段中service强加关联，但"用户关系网复杂详尽"不等于"其服务品质好"。

questions.stemEn: Linking phone numbers to Facebook identities may ______.
questions.analysis: 事实细节题。第二段第一句指出Facebook背弃承诺，将电话号码与Facebook ID挂钩。其危害是：即使不了解信息的具体内容，但消息接收者与发送者的信息也会极大程度上泄露内情（enormously revealing），如此一来用户自然会面临隐私威胁，[C]正确。[A]源于第二段第三句政治相关者们无不想知道首相的政敌正在哪个WhatsApp群里活跃，但此处实为例证，借助最敏感的政治问题来强调关联后泄密程度之甚，选项属于过度推断。[B]利用revealing、records等词干扰，将泄露用户信息偷换为搞乱用户信息。[D]源于第一句Facebook事先向欧委会许下承诺、达成目的后又毁约，但误导欧委会的是Facebook的承诺内容（不关联），而非题干所述的毁约之举（关联）。

options.label: C
options.contentEn: pose a risk to Facebook users

questions.stemEn: According to the author, competition law ______.
questions.analysis: 作者观点题。由题干关键词competition law定位至第三段。第二句直接指出，竞争法笨拙不堪（clumsy），第三、四句引出原因之一：它跟不上数字经济变化的速度（very slow compared to the pace of change within the digital economy），[D]符合文意。[A]由第四句"新的权力滥用取代了旧问题"臆断而来，但该句意在说明竞争法更新太慢：好不容易解决了问题，新垄断又形成了；新的市场权力恰恰是竞争法意欲约束的对象，而非其所服务的对象。[B]利用imbalances、economy、financial disadvantage等碎片信息干扰，但作者仅指出其无法遏制数字巨头垄断、维护用户权益，并未表明其对宏观经济的影响。[C]由第二、三句"the only way to address"、"clumsy"过度推测而来，但文意是说竞争法作为目前唯一能应对垄断的方式，整体未能跟上现实发展，而非质疑其具体策略单一。

options.label: A
options.contentEn: should serve the new market powers

options.label: C
options.contentEn: should not provide just one legal solution

options.label: D
options.contentEn: cannot keep pace with the changing market

questions.stemEn: Competition law as presently interpreted can hardly protect Facebook users because ______.
questions.analysis: 因果细节题。第三段第五句引出竞争法的第二个问题：概念性问题。第六句进而解释：当前所阐释的法律是保护消费者不受经济损失（deals with financial disadvantage to consumers），但问题在于用户（users）没有为服务付钱（don't pay for them），不能算作消费者，因而他们难以受到法律保护的原因在于身份定位问题，即没被定义为消费者（顾客），[A]正确。[B]将第六句"用户不（用）为服务买单（don't pay for them）"篡改为"经济上无能力为服务买单（not financially reliable）"。[C]偏离文意：竞争法的保护效力并不由服务或产品性质决定，而是由其对象是否购买产品或服务（即是否为消费者）决定。[D]把第七、八句"Facebook的顾客是那些付钱买广告的人"扭曲为"Facebook的服务是广告主偿付的"。

options.label: A
options.contentEn: they are not defined as customers

options.label: D
options.contentEn: the services are paid for by advertisers

questions.stemEn: The ants analogy is used to illustrate ______.
questions.analysis: 修辞推理题。末段第二句把动物界现象（蚂蚁养殖、保护蚜虫以获取蜜露）与我们的世界（Google养殖/保护我们以获取我们的数据）相类比（Just as some ants farm the bugs called aphids for the honeydew..., so Google farms us for the data...）；末句对这种关系加以讽刺（It doesn't feel like a human or democratic relationship, even if both sides benefit）。可见该类比意在揭示以Google、Facebook为代表的科技巨头VS用户之间的不平等关系，[D]符合文义。[A]从蚂蚁养蚜虫、蚜虫以蜜露供养蚂蚁的关系中得出两者互利的结论，但选项只聚焦数字巨头之间，不涉及用户；其次忽略作者在文末以及全文所体现的批驳态度。[B]将文中"farm the bugs...for..."（为……而养）所体现的利用关系扭曲为竞争关系，同样不涉及用户。[C]从蚜虫有人养、有人护的情形中臆测出用户享受实惠，与作者态度相悖。

options.label: A
options.contentEn: a win-win business model between digital giants

options.label: B
options.contentEn: a typical competition pattern among digital giants

options.label: C
options.contentEn: the benefits provided for digital giants' customers

options.label: D
options.contentEn: the relationship between digital giants and their users

questions.stemEn: The key to mastering the art of deep work is to ______.
questions.analysis: 事实细节题。第二段在概述了深度工作的几种方法后指出：无论采取哪种方法，关键是（the key is to...）要确定你的专注时间并严格坚守（determine your length of focus time and stick to it）。可知掌握这一技巧的关键是坚守预定的专注时间，[A]keep to your focus time是对原文stick to it（it=focus time）的明确改写。[B]将第四段信息"把待办事项按优先次序列出清单（craft our to-do lists）"曲解为"列出紧急任务的清单（list your immediate tasks）"，且这只是具体方法之一，并非题目所问关键要诀。[C]将第二段第一句"dedicated to a specific task"和"developing a daily ritual"所述两种具体方法糅杂为"make specific daily plans"，并将其当做掌握深度工作艺术的关键。[D]源自第一段"putting a premium on being busy"以及第二段第一句"seizing moments of deep work"，但时时刻刻忙碌工作是本文反对的低效做法。

questions.stemEn: The study in the early 1980s cited by Harford shows that ______.
questions.analysis: 事实细节题。根据题干关键词study in the early 1980s、Harford定位到第四、五段。文中首先指出研究方法：将大学生分成两组，一组制定月度计划，一组制定详细的每日计划（第四段第二句）。随后论述研究发现：详细的每日计划反而使学生失去动力（the detailed daily plans demotivated students），留出临时应变空间才能实现最佳效果（第五段）。可见[D]正确——概括了第五段第一句：as expected对应句所述研究者预期；detailed plans may not be as fruitful概括the detailed daily plans demotivated students...ineffective。[A]与第五段第二句"不可避免的干扰因素往往会使每日任务清单无效（ineffective）"完全相悖。[B]将第五段第一句研究者预期当做事实，但原文随后指出预期错误。[C]偷换概念：使学生受挫的是详尽的每日计划（daily plans），而非每月目标（monthly goals）。

options.label: B
options.contentEn: daily schedules are indispensable to studying

options.label: C
options.contentEn: students are hardly motivated by monthly goals

options.label: D
options.contentEn: detailed plans may not be as fruitful as expected

questions.stemEn: According to Newport, idleness is ______.
questions.analysis: 人物观点题。根据题干中Newport、idleness定位至第七段Newport观点：闲散是大脑所必需（it is as indispensable to the brain as vitamin D is to the body），对于完成任何工作来说都非常必要（[idleness] is, paradoxically, necessary to getting any work done）。可见[D]正确——是对原文的完全同义改写。[A]夸大其词：将Newport观点"大脑在工作状态之外需要适时放松"夸大为"闲散可取，忙碌不可取"，用闲散替代忙碌。[B]强加关联：将第七段类比"闲散是大脑必需，就像维生素D是人体必需"糅杂为"懒散是维持人体健康的重要因素"。[C]将第六段"闲散可以使我们充分利用精力（make the most of...energy）"曲解为"可以节约精力（save energy）"，并对"downtime"（停工，休息）的构词down+time望文生义，臆断出"节约时间（save time）"。

options.label: A
options.contentEn: a desirable mental state for busy people

options.label: B
options.contentEn: a major contributor to physical health

options.label: C
options.contentEn: an effective way to save time and energy

options.label: D
options.contentEn: an essential factor in accomplishing any work

questions.stemEn: Pillay believes that our brains' shift between being focused and unfocused ______.
questions.analysis: 人物观点题。根据题干人物Pillay定位至第八、九段。第八段第二句指出Pillay观点：当大脑在专注状态和非专注状态之间切换时，往往更有效率（When our brains switch between being focused and unfocused on a task, they tend to be more efficient），可见[B]正确——是对原文的同义改写：shift对应switch；greater efficiency对应be more efficient。[A]由文中psychiatry一词捏造出psychological well-being，但这是关于Pillay人物身份的介绍，与其观点无关。[C]将第八段末句"在专注于某项任务和非专注于该任务之间切换（on a task）"曲解为"平衡工作内的不同任务（balance in work）"。[D]利用文中task一词设置干扰，但Pillay并未提及工作的紧迫性（urgency属于捏造信息）。

options.label: C
options.contentEn: is aimed at better balance in work

questions.stemEn: This text is mainly about ______.
questions.analysis: 文章主旨题。本文第一段提出全文话题：拒绝低效忙碌，打造深度工作的习惯（building a habit of "deep work"）。第二段说明深度工作的多种基本方法及唯一不变的宗旨（the key is to determine your length of focus time and stick to it）。第三至九段论述深度工作、提高工作效率的多种具体策略：深度规划（deep scheduling）、反思日常计划、拥抱闲暇让大脑在专注和分心之间切换。可见[B]approaches to getting more done in less time体现全文核心话题——是对building a habit of deep work、combat constant interruptions and get more done in less time等文章主旨的高度概括。[A]将文章意旨"避免陷入过度重视忙碌的陷阱"曲解为与之存在巨大偏差的"缓解忙碌生活的紧张"。[C]虽算是文章关键信息，但相对全篇太窄——文章并非从始至终都局限于如何排除干扰，而是更高一层地讨论如何实现深度、高效工作。[D]偏离文章主线：文中主要论述坚守专注时间的方法，而非集中讨论缺乏专注的原因。

options.label: A
options.contentEn: ways to relieve the tension of busy life

options.label: B
options.contentEn: approaches to getting more done in less time

options.label: D
options.contentEn: the cause of the lack of focus time

questions.stemEn: Researchers think that guilt can be a good thing because it may help ___.
questions.analysis: 细节题。定位到第一段末句"This is why researchers generally regard so-called moral guilt, in the right amount, to be a good thing"，This指代前文内容：孩子通过说"对不起"来安抚父母和朋友，抚慰自己的良心（appease parents and friends — and their own consciences）。这说明内疚感有助于孩子学习道德规范和社会行为，促进其道德发展。选项C "foster a child's moral development"（促进孩子的道德发展）与原文含义一致。选项A "regulate a child's basic emotions"偷换概念，原文说的是内疚不同于basic emotions，而非调节基本情绪。选项B "improve a child's intellectual ability"原文未提及智力发展。选项D "intensify a child's positive feelings"与原文相反，guilt本质上是一种负面情感。

questions.stemEn: According to Paragraph 2, many people still consider guilt to be ___.
questions.analysis: 细节题。第二段首句指出"In the popular imagination, of course, guilt still gets a bad rap"（在大众的想象中，内疚感仍然名声不佳），紧接着第二句用比喻说明原因："it's the emotional equivalent of wearing a jacket weighted with stones"（如同一件装满石头的夹克，让人深感负担）。选项B "burdensome"（沉重的、负担重的）准确概括了这个比喻的含义，即人们认为内疚是一种情感负担。选项A "deceptive"（欺骗性的）、选项C "addictive"（上瘾的）、选项D "inexcusable"（不可原谅的），在原文中均未提及。

questions.stemEn: Vaish holds that the rethinking about guilt comes from an awareness that ___.
questions.analysis: 观点细节题。定位到第二段Vaish的话："this revival is part of a larger recognition that emotions aren't binary – feelings that may be advantageous in one context may be harmful in another"，即情绪并非二元对立的（aren't binary），同一种情绪在一种情境下有利，在另一种情境下有害。这表明了情绪可以扮演相反的角色。选项D "an emotion can play opposing roles"（一种情绪可以扮演相反的角色）是原文的直接同义转述。选项A "emotions are context-independent"与原文相反（应该是context-dependent）。选项B和C原文未提及。

questions.stemEn: By saying "one of the harder challenges," the author implies that ___.
